recommendation_summary: Keep nightly-sync on edna, wrap its startup so any exception sends a failure email, and add a dead-man's check pinged on success that alerts the user if no ping arrives by about 04:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: nightly-sync must alert when it fails or never runs without log reading, per your note after 4 silent crashes.
labels.Deleted: central log on Synology, moving nightly-sync to Docker, full rebuild.
labels.Bottleneck: crash happens before the email step, so missing success email is invisible and detection waits there, not in log storage.
labels.Checked myself: per your note only: cron 03:00 on edna, email only on finish, 4 startup token failures last week, no other alert, you will not read logs.

note: The reply recommends two separate alerts to set up now: an exception-triggered failure email and a dead-man's heartbeat check, which makes it LARGER rather than SMALL.
